title: feat(port): slice 132 — i.A()/i.z()/g.ak() + S12/S33/S34 ledge & ladder arms
body:
## Summary

Ports the ladder/ledge traversal chain: `i.A()` ladder-cell check, `i.z()` column wall scan, `g.ak()` ledge-lip grab, `g.aA()` wall-kick marker spawn, and their three consumer arms — S12 (dismount/swing → `i(74)` ladder snap, `i(107|108|109)` edge anims, `ak()` grab or `i(33)` wall-rebound), S33 (wall-rebound jump: direction-press vault, `a(43,32)` fall, or the i4/i5 pocket-scan lip grab), S34 (rise partner).

Two test-caught fixes: the earlier S12 stub wrongly ran `groundedTail` after the arm (the original case breaks to post-switch — `l()`'s L120 fold overwrote `i(74)` with `i(11)`); and the JADX `while(true)` pocket scan drops an else-break — ported as `while (i13 < 2)` (the only non-hanging reconstruction, `high-confidence`).

`MarkerWorld` gained an optional `cellFn` for position-dependent cells.

Gates: verifier `ok:true`, 57 unittests, `:core:test` 905 (+10), `:android:assembleDebug`, `:gdx:build`. Plan doc: `plans/260922-0430-slice132-ledge-ladder/`.
